senses.definition: n.pr.m. (my brother is help, cf. Assyrian Aḫulêʾte, my brother is strength, DlPr 202)
a chief of Dan Nu 1:12; 2:25; 7:66, 71; 10:25.
one of David’s heroes 1 Ch 12:3.
